standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers local finite type from the diagonal to the isomorphism space.

core_obligations: Reformulate: the sheaf of isomorphisms between two objects is the fibre product of the diagonal with the sheaf of isomorphisms of their images in the base (proof lines 285-297)

Transfer the property: the diagonal is representable by algebraic spaces locally of finite type and the other factor is a base change of it, so the fibre product is locally of finite type, giving the assertion (proof lines 298-307)
proof_roadmap: Isom_X(x_1, x_2) 是 Δ 与 Isom_Y(f(x_1), f(x_2)) 在 T 上的纤维积。

difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the isomorphism space of two objects of an algebraic stack over a common test object is an algebraic space locally of finite type over that test object (author lemma at source lines 277-283, label lemma-isom-locally-finite-type). The proof (source lines 285-308) exhibits the isomorphism space as a fibre product involving the diagonal of the stack and transfers local finite type from the diagonal (proof lines 285-307). The fibre product description is the substance. H3.
